_readme: Stress scenario and threshold flags. The demo page reads this file, so its sliders start at these values and use the same formulas (see creditmemo/stress.py).
_why_leverage_without_leases: The stress leverage test uses funded debt / EBITDA, the way bank covenants are usually written. The grade uses (debt + leases) / EBITDAR, the way rating agencies compare companies with different lease books. Same result on either measure for all three companies (FY2025 stressed): DVA 5.47x / 4.99x, UNP 3.44x / 3.43x, KSS 5.66x / 6.92x.
